notes: Every expected value below is transcribed from the RNG-7 table and was reproduced bit for bit by the independent implementation in src/rng.rs (SHA-256 + SplitMix64 per RNG-2…RNG-6) before being committed.
Encodings (RNG-2/RNG-3): LE64 = 8-byte little-endian; the seed is the first 8 digest bytes read back as a little-endian u64; tags are ASCII; the slug is UTF-8.

RNG-4 entity packing (kind << 32) | id applies only to per-market execution streams: kind 1 = OrderKey, 2 = CancelSeq, 3 = TradeSeq, 4 = OpKey, 5 = execution-command sequence, 6 = input row index. Feed streams use the raw element identities of 14 F-51 (no packing).
RNG-5: h = mix64(stream_seed ^ mix64(entity + G)); draw(i) = mix64(h + G x (i + 1)); G = 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; all wrapping u64.

RNG-6 mappings: uniform in [0, n) accepts u = draw(i) when u < n x floor(2^64 / n) and returns u mod n (retry on i + 1); integer uniform in [a, b] = a + uniform in [0, b - a + 1); open unit u = ((draw(i) >> 11) + 0.5) x 2^-53.
The reference check of SplitMix64 itself: from state 0, outputs 0xe220a8397b1dcdaf, 0x6e789e6aa1b965f4 (state += G before each mix64).

determinism_properties.statement: market_seed and every stream seed depend only on (run_seed, slug) and the tag; idx, candidate index, worker, thread, profile, strategy and wall clock never enter them.
run_seed is an integer in [0, 2^53 - 1]; the producer refuses anything else at submit; the binary never chooses a seed; default 0.
ts-compat with jitterMs = 0 gives identical output for any two seeds; realistic with zero-variance (constant) latency models gives identical output for any two seeds.
A draw is a pure function of (stream, entity, i), never of call order.
